answer: Deferred Liability Registry: each agent identity posts no deposit, but its operator must underwrite a rolling liability band. A nebula of fresh wallets from one operator still shares the same underwriter, so the band widens with every identity and the per-identity premium climbs at a superlinear zenith. On any successful sybil exploit, cleanup costs are charged against the operator's entire band, not the offending wallet. An echo of the penalty then follows the operator across new identities.
